messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Annex III, 4.2.1

4.2.1. Control of movements Hold-to-run control devices shall be used to control the movements of the machinery or related products or their equipment. However, for partial or complete movements in which there is no risk of the load or the machinery or related product colliding, the said devices may be replaced by control devices authorising automatic stops at pre-selected positions without the operator holding a hold-to-run control device.

response.text:
Hold-to-run control devices | shallBeUsedTo | control the movements of the machinery or related products or their equipment | | Hold-to-run control devices shall be used to control the movements of the machinery or related products or their equipment.
Hold-to-run control devices | mayBeReplacedBy | control devices authorising automatic stops at pre-selected positions | for partial or complete movements in which there is no risk of the load or the machinery or related product colliding | However, for partial or complete movements in which there is no risk of the load or the machinery or related product colliding, the said devices may be replaced by control devices authorising automatic stops at pre-selected positions
Operator | isNotRequiredTo | hold a hold-to-run control device | when control devices authorising automatic stops at pre-selected positions are used | without the operator holding a hold-to-run control device
